text:
pagerbot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0421 - suspicious auth header snippets seen in log-forwarder -> external endpoint (severity: P1)

dan_oncall: got the page, seeing lots of short-lived requests to /v1/auth/validate from a single egress IP, 10.4.16.23, across multiple tenants. rate ~250r/s for last 7m.

alice_sre: confirming - log-shipper shows truncated auth header snippets in forwarded payloads to analytics partner. snippets include Bearer partial tokens. potential exposure window ~23:12-23:18 UTC.

dan_oncall: initiating containment steps: 1) block egress to analytics partner host (ingress-egress-fw rule deployed) 2) enable strict rate-limit ingress for auth endpoints 3) tag logs as sensitive and pause external forwards.

ben_sec: thanks. start key-rotation plan now. which tokens are affected? are these service tokens or end-user tokens?

alice_sre: appears to be a mix. majority are service-account tokens used by our internal telemetry exporter; small subset seem user-session tokens — we need a mapping. Carla, can you pull mapping from token-issuer logs?

carla_prod: on it. pulling issue logs and token introspection for affected token prefixes. ETA 8m.

deploybot: rollback of log-forwarder v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 requested by dan_oncall. Deployment queued and will start in 2m.

erin_cs: heads-up: we should prepare a customer notification template for potentially affected customers. I'll draft and hand off to legal for review.

fiona_legal: review incoming. prioritize accuracy: do not confirm leaked customer PII yet. request that CS avoid naming customers until we have mapping.

ben_sec: once Carla confirms which tokens, we'll rotate service tokens immediately via KMS rotate-key job. For user session tokens, we'll push a forced refresh with short TTLs and invalidate affected sessions. Prepare revocation endpoints.

alice_sre: containment checklist executed so far: egress block applied, forwarder paused, deploy rollback queued, WAF rule added to drop suspicious UA strings, KV cache for token introspection snapshots frozen.

dan_oncall: switching on-call to alice_sre for live handling. tagging handoff. alice_sre you now own the incident.

alice_sre: taking over. dan, leave any notes in the incident doc. I'll run token-scan across the auth-db and produce affected-tenant list.

carla_prod: mapping done. 14 service accounts (internal exporters) and 5 customer tenants have at least one partial token match in forwarded logs. sending list to ben_sec and erin_cs.

ben_sec: starting service token rotation: running incremental rotate-job for listed service accounts. command:
```
sh tools/rotate_service_tokens.sh --accounts-file=affected_svc_accounts.txt --kdf=KMS-1 --parallel=4
```
Expected completion ~6m.

erin_cs: drafted customer note: short, factual, apology, recommended action (rotate API keys, check integrations). attaching to thread for legal review.

fiona_legal: small edits made, removing speculative language. CS can send for the 5 affected customers only after confirm by sec+prod.

alice_sre: live mitigation update: WAF rules catching repeaters, rate has fallen to ~30r/s. rolling token rotation for service accounts ~50% done.

ben_sec: service tokens rotated. next: coordinate session invalidation for affected customers. what is customer impact?

erin_cs: initial CS assessment: 5 customers potentially impacted, none reported user errors yet. we'll pre-warn and offer 1:1 support.

alice_sre: we need to rotate any ingest API keys stored in customer-managed config? check with account team.

carla_prod: confirmed two customers use managed-agent which pulled config; their agents were forwarding logs to the external partner. flagged both for immediate key reset suggestions.

ben_sec: recommended actions for CS to communicate: 1) rotate API keys/credentials 2) reissue tokens where applicable 3) confirm no PII in forwarded payloads (we are investigating).

fiona_legal: escalate if PII confirmed. preserve all evidence. no customer-wide public statement until sec signs off.

alice_sre: post-mitigation plan: full audit of log-forwarder config, add deny-by-default external-forwarding in config, require explicit ACLs for any third-party ship, and add sensoring to strip auth headers from forwarded payloads.

dan_oncall: thanks team, leaving notes: blocked egress, paused forwards, rollback started, rotation in progress. handing back to alice for long-running tasks.

alice_sre: creating follow-up ticket INC-2026-0421-FOLLOWUP for retros and config harden. assign to eng-ml and infra.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATED: severity -> P1; status -> mitigated; assignees -> alice_sre, ben_sec, erin_cs.

alice_sre: final notes: mitigation successful for immediate exposure. rotating keys and customer outreach underway. will update once we confirm whether any user-level tokens were reconstructed from snippets. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
